name: Giant Hunter (Kneecapper Training)
text: **Giant Hunter (Kneecapper Training)**: Kneecapper dwarves gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoids with the giant subtype. Furthermore, they gain a +2 bonus on Survival checks to find and follow tracks made by humanoids with the giant subtype. This racial trait replaces the hatred racial trait.
